summary: Tinode is a self-hosted instant messaging platform built with a Go backend. It provides official clients across Swift for iOS, Java for Android, a JavaScript web application, command-line scripts, and support for automated chatbots.
goodFor: Developers looking to deploy a custom, self-hosted chat system with multi-platform client support and chatbot integration.
watchOut: It operates in a crowded space dominated by widely adopted open-source chat alternatives, which may offer more extensive community documentation and integrations.
deployNotes: As a Go application, it typically compiles into a single binary that benefits from a reverse proxy for TLS termination and a persistent database backend for message storage.
